approval.governing_rule_reference: TACHYOS_STRATEGY_BACKBONE_V1.md / PID12256 Lazarus anti-spray; October31 independent recovery coexistence; November3 EMA9 authority; PID7812/PID14312 preservation
approval.source: Existing governing recovery anti-spray and October31 coexistence rules require a genuinely independent physical mission; the November3 current-parent authority rule binds first-floor runway to the living physical parent/Release. PID4824 records same-parent/same-arc overlapping renewals through Commander timestamps and a local continuation-only +200% override against a known current opposite parent. These corrections complete those rules. No new policy permission is inferred from the upload, the losses or later quote peaks.

default_workflow_change: None: 45-minute PAPER entry window, normal drain, verified complete original archive and exact numbered upload parts; replay remains optional.
excluded_changes: No broad countertrend ban, entry-count cap or new flat-inventory reentry restriction
No entry-price ceiling, tier, 30/180-second rule or profit-percentage change
No unknown-parent prohibition or removal of genuinely earned Release/runner authority
No original record alteration, interpreter spoof or full original replay claim
No invented post-denial inventory, alternate full-run profit or additive repair savings
No Looking Glass projection, Quote-Wave activation, live order or native Windows verification claim

scope.A_B_C: Preserve the previously authorized Release custody, established-parent transfer and calibrated later Heist corrections.
scope.PID15184_CURRENT_PARENT_CALIBRATION: Complete the previously authorized first-counter observation rule using the already current, source-bound living EMA9 mission parent before long historical residence qualifies. Preserve correct chapter continuity and make the later-Heist calibration marker use the same keyed observation. No price, size, clock, custody or profit-floor parameter changes. The remaining source change is runtime identity only.
scope.PID17588_SCOUT_LATE_TP: Complete the already-authorized PID8552 last-120-second return rule by calling the existing _late_counter_return_has_runway predicate inside historical_extreme_release_candidates. Keep existing timing, target, price, custody and independent entry-family rules. The other source edit is runtime identity only.
scope.PID19996_COMPLETE_UPLOADS: Include normal raw BTC source recording, keep file-backed export progress independent of console display, publish only verified complete bytes, and automatically make smaller lossless uploads from the exact new archive.
scope.PID19996_RAIL_VALUE: Defer an earned expensive opening continuation during an opposed short-window dip; retain the same parent opportunity through the existing first300s observation window and admit only a current cheaper <=35c rejoin with existing route, runway, source, book, inventory and admission proof. Bind and consume the original opportunity at authoritative admission.
scope.PID19996_RESEARCH_IDENTITY: Keep physical legs across harmless labels and rollover, scope quote returns by exact ticker, distinguish partial observation from true leg end, reject invalid legacy comparables, and correct enum/string same-side diagnostics.
scope.PID19996_SOURCE_FRESHNESS: Share the existing bounded physical-source clock policy using exact captured receipt, epoch, sequence and continuity evidence; preserve strict local quote time and conservative historical proofs. Never rewrite timestamps.
scope.PID4596_NULL_EXIT_ESTIMATE: Repair an implementation error exposed by the returned PID4596 recording. An unavailable optional tactical exit estimate retains its advisory reason and produces no suggested price. Re-review clears a stale suggestion. Finite estimates and the full-arc fallback retain their formulas. All proposed non-metadata intent fields remain unchanged for One Commander. The only other production edit is the runtime release identity.
scope.PID4824_FLOOR_AUTHORITY: A local continuation cannot independently raise the first-floor threshold to +200% when a verified current living mission parent opposes the held side. Preserve genuine current same-side Release, current aligned-parent runway, unknown/stale-parent fallback, existing percentages and all already-armed protection. Runtime label updated.
scope.PID4824_RECOVERY_IDENTITY: Enforce the existing recovery coexistence requirement using source-bound physical owner/arc and continuity rather than route or extreme-timestamp identity. A same-side Lazarus wound cannot create a new paid shot on an unchanged physical event. Preserve genuine new physical owners/arcs, separately validated measured renewal, opposite handoffs, and ordinary flat-inventory admission.
